hooks.text: 取消固定职责与硬克制，并允许比赛中途更换能力即时重组战术
hooks.excerpt: Ditch the roles, hard counters and last hits in Sirocco. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, load up auto-firing weapons , and craft strategies on the fly.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 自动开火与经济系统把重点从补刀NPC转向团战和站位
hooks.excerpt: Sirocco utilizes an auto-fire mechanic and economic system that promotes team fighting and positioning over last hitting NPCs.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 团队经济确保无论个人战绩10比0还是0比10，每名队友仍对胜利关键
hooks.excerpt: In Sirocco, teams win, not individuals, so whether you are 10-0 or 0-10, our economic system ensures all your friends are critical to achieving victory.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 声音设计强化张力、冲击与临场感

excerpts.excerpt: The sound design helps build tension, deliver impact, and make each moment feel alive on the water.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 同类武器不能重复使用

excerpts.excerpt: 武器只能2个，同样的武器还不能用，技能比武器强
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 中程武器偏弱，远程武器主导战斗

excerpts.excerpt: Mid-range weapons feel particularly underpowered—right now, the combat meta is dominated by long-range weapons.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 一匹配就5分钟起步，还没有亚洲服务器。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 友方与敌方技能难以区分

excerpts.excerpt: it's hard to tell the difference between teammate and enemy abilities
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高分段排队时间可能较长

excerpts.excerpt: Queue times, especially at higher MMR, can get long.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 可探索的玩法风格很多

excerpts.excerpt: Lots of fun playstyles to explore
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 不同舰船身份明确，覆盖刺客、坦克、辅助和远程等玩法。

excerpts.excerpt: each with a clear identity and purpose — from assassin-style boats to tanky frontliners, supportive builds, long-range snipers, and close-combat bruisers.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏容易让玩家长时间沉浸投入

excerpts.excerpt: I've sat and played all day without realizing it.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
